en.headline: German film festival KINO/26 opens tonight in Sai Wan Ho
en.dek: The Goethe-Institut programme begins on 17 September with Fatih Akin’s Amrum at the Hong Kong Film Archive, and runs into early October at several cinemas.
body: The German film festival KINO/26 opens in Hong Kong on Thursday evening, with Fatih Akin’s Amrum screening at 7pm at the Hong Kong Film Archive cinema in Sai Wan Ho.

The Goethe-Institut Hong Kong said the festival runs from 17 September to 4 October and presents new German titles across several venues, including the Film Archive, Broadway Cinematheque and MOViE MOViE Pacific Place. The Film Archive’s September calendar lists further KINO/26 screenings through 27 September, with tickets at 70 dollars and a concession price of 56 dollars.

Amrum, the opening film, is a 2025 German feature about a boy growing up on a North Sea island in the closing stretch of the Second World War. The wider programme also includes Volker Schlöndorff’s Visitation and other recent German productions, according to the organiser.
The Film Archive is a short walk from Sai Wan Ho MTR Exit A. The Goethe-Institut said tickets went on sale from 17 August.

zh.headline: 德國電影節KINO/26今晚西灣河揭幕
zh.dek: 歌德學院主辦的影展由9月17日起舉行，開幕片為法提阿金的《小島無戰事》，晚上7時於香港電影資料館放映。
body: 德國電影節KINO/26周四晚上在香港揭幕，開幕片法提阿金執導的《小島無戰事》晚上7時於西灣河香港電影資料館電影院放映。
歌德學院（香港）表示，影展由9月17日至10月4日舉行，在電影資料館、百老匯電影中心及MOViE MOViE太古廣場等地放映德國新作。電影資料館9月節目表列出的KINO/26場次至9月27日，門票正價70元，特惠56元。
開幕片《小島無戰事》是2025年德國作品，講述二次大戰接近結束時，一名男孩在北海小島成長的故事。主辦單位表示，節目亦包括伏加舒倫杜夫的《百年孤宅》及其他近期德國電影。
電影資料館鄰近港鐵西灣河站A出口。歌德學院表示門票已於8月17日起發售。
